title: Endorium Mod
description: Endorium is an end-game expansion mod for Minecraft that introduces a new mini boss, new wood type and new tier of equipment beyond Netherite.
body:
From Creator: "Mod is made completely out of my boredom. I am trying to learn how things works. That way U can track whole progress."

Endorium Mod
Endorium is an end-game expansion mod for Minecraft that introduces a new tier of equipment beyond Netherite. By exploring the depths of the End dimension, players can discover a mysterious new ore and forge gear with superior durability, protection, and enchantability. The mod maintains the vanilla feel while providing a new, challenging goal for late-game survival.

Added Items and Features:

Endorium Ore: A new, rare ore that generates naturally within the End Stone on the outer End islands.

Endorium Shard & Ingot: The core crafting materials obtained from mining the ore and combining the shards.

Endorium Upgrade Template: A unique smithing template required to upgrade your existing Netherite gear.

Endorium Armor Set: A complete set of armor upgraded from Netherite via the Smithing Table. It provides increased armor toughness, higher knockback resistance, better enchantability, and retains lava immunity.

Endorium Tools & Weapons: Upgraded versions of Netherite tools and swords, offering higher base damage, faster mining speed, and extended durability.

New World Generation & Encounters:

End Villages: The End is no longer completely desolate! Discover newly generated settlements scattered across the islands. These modular villages bring life to the dimension, featuring custom structures, unique paths, and hidden chests containing valuable randomized loot.

New End Trees: A brand-new type of tree naturally generating in the End ecosystem. This introduces a unique source of wood, providing players with fresh building blocks and allowing for basic survival and crafting directly within the dimension.

New Boss Encounter: Face off against a formidable, brand-new boss lurking in the End - **Broodmother**. (Note: The boss currently has no drops, but a highly valuable item crucial for further end-game progression is planned for future updates)
